assets.gate_reason: New Sunwall golden-mountain wall family for Gates of Morning (784 cells, 31% of the town). Identity and rule contract recorded from source and a fixture probe before generation; one native-alpha master, the exporter builds all 16 masks x 2 parities.
assets.native_name: GOLDEN_MOUNTAIN Gates of Morning Sunwall mountain
assets.scope: Gates of Morning (town-gates-of-morning) only: GOLDEN_MOUNTAIN and GOLDEN_MOUNTAIN_WALL1-6, the mountain ring and southern coast.

references.note: Native Sunwall golden mountain: warm golden crumpled rock. Keep its golden-sandstone identity, not its bright value.
Accepted board mountain construction: one broad raised block with a large top plane and thick front face, soft upper-left light. Use its mass, camera and scale, not its grey palette.

grid_contract.movement: Blocks all movement; no pass_wall or pass_tree exception.
grid_contract.sight: Blocks line of sight, sense and ESP.
grid_contract.interaction: None: not diggable, no door, no transition.
grid_contract.export: Native-alpha solid central mountain block with transparent margins; exporter crops its broad top plane and front face into cell-filling 16-way N/E/S/W wall masks and two parities.

prompt_fields.subject: A SINGLE massive raised block of Sunwall mountain: warm weathered golden sandstone, one broad continuous gently uneven top plateau with horizontal sandstone strata and a few large planar fractures, and one thick near-vertical front cliff face with stacked strata bands. Solid impassable mountain rock, not a pile of stones.
prompt_fields.palette: Deep burnt-ochre, amber and umber-brown sandstone with thin warm gold highlights along the upper-left ridge edges and sparse faint gold mineral veins. The top plateau is mid-dark amber; the front cliff face is clearly darker dark-umber brown. Overall value noticeably darker than pale plaza stone, grass or beach sand; never bright yellow or lemon.
prompt_fields.contrast: At 48 pixels it must read as one heavy solid golden-brown rock mass filling most of its square cell, clearly darker and more massive than floor, sand, grass or road. Distinct from grey mountains by its warm sandstone hue. No thin spikes, foliage, rubble, holes, gaps or floor visible between parts of the block.
prompt_fields.composition: One nearly square, wide and tall coherent mass in overhead three-quarter tabletop view. Broad top plateau from about 15% to 60% of the image height, front cliff face below it to about 90%. Solid footprint about 85-90% of canvas width and 75-85% of height. COMPLETE shape inside the canvas with at least 7% genuinely transparent inset on all four sides and transparent corners. No cut-off rock. The exporter will extend the rock material to connected cell edges.
prompt_fields.mechanics: Undiggable Sunwall mountain; blocks movement, line of sight, sense and ESP. No danger symbols, lava, snow, door, stairs, building, banner, sun emblem or character.
